name: dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200

irregularities.what: the console's own login list CONSOLE (local only, so a local user always gets in there)
the 'enable' list (it asks the server first, so nobody needs a shared enable password)
irregularities.statement: aaa authentication enable default group LAB-TACACS enable

irregularities.what: the login method of line con 0: login authentication CONSOLE (the device has: the login method of line con 0: login authentication default)
the commands of privilege level 7: 2 statements
irregularities.statement: e.g. privilege exec all level 7 monitor capture

region: ! aaa: the method lists tacctl renders, each replaced by the rendered line (the console's own list is local only)
aaa authentication enable default group LAB-TACACS enable
! roles: the privilege lines of the levels tacctl renders
privilege exec all level 7 monitor capture
privilege exec level 7 clear mac address-table dynamic
! aaa: the login method of the console and vty lines
after: ! If any line printed "% Invalid" or "% Error", stop and undo it: tacctl device config plan
! dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 --backout (its own region, to paste in the second terminal).
! Check now (nothing rolls this back by itself):
!   From the tacctl server:   tacctl device config pull dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 --diff     (aaa and roles: ok)
!   In the second terminal:   open a NEW ssh session to dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 as yourself, then: terminal length 0, show privilege (must say 15)
! When both checks are fine, type this one command yourself:  write memory
! To undo: tacctl device config plan dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 --backout (tacctl keeps this plan's
! back-out: after the check pull has replaced the picture, the command still prints this plan's,
! and says which pull it undoes, until the next plan with changes)
! Do not: 'write memory' before the check; paste outside the banners; paste into another device;
! paste on a console more than twenty lines at a time; keep this output in a file after the paste
backout: ! back-out: the lines as the pull showed them
no privilege exec level 7 clear mac address-table dynamic
no privilege exec all level 7 monitor capture
! (on IOS 15.x a removed privilege line may stay as 'privilege exec level <default> <cmd>'
no aaa authentication enable default group LAB-TACACS enable
no aaa authentication login CONSOLE local
warnings: the device has no enable secret: with the server unreachable, level 15 is reached only through the local user and 'aaa authorization exec'; set an enable secret first if you want a second way
